_comment: Pluggable music-generation backends. Keys are engine ids. Secrets are never stored here — MiniMax API keys come from MINIMAX_API_KEY or Settings.

minimax_music3_comfy.name: MiniMax Music 3 (local ComfyUI)
minimax_music3_comfy.description: Run MiniMax Music 3 weights on your own ComfyUI. No API key. Requires comfy_base_url and the Music 3 DiT / text-encoder / DAV files.

minimax_music3_api.name: MiniMax Music 3 (hosted API)
minimax_music3_api.description: Hosted MiniMax Music 3. Set MINIMAX_API_KEY or Settings → minimax_api_key. This is Music 3, not MiniMax H3 video.
